[attribute-source-type]
=== `@source-type` Source Type

This attribute can be used with two elements: to identify the kind of source providing an award that sponsored a work or the research on which a work was based (with the element <<element-funding-source,`<funding-source>`>>); or to identify the type of publication, for example, a “`book`”, “`guide`”, or “`database`” that is (or contains) the target of the <<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>>.

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-funding-source,`<funding-source>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| Type of entity (such as an organization or an individual) that is the source
                        of an award which sponsors a work or the research underlying the work.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| The type of object named in the related object (<<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>>) element, for example, a 
                        “`database`”.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
